departments.name: Police
departments.blurb: Patrol, investigations, dispatch, records and animal control.
departments.cutNarrative: Slower response times, thinner patrol coverage overnight, longer case backlogs.
departments.raiseNarrative: Fills sworn vacancies and restores overnight patrol strength.

departments.name: Fire & Emergency Services
departments.blurb: Fire suppression, medical first response, prevention and inspection.
departments.cutNarrative: Browned-out engine companies and longer medical response intervals.
departments.raiseNarrative: Adds firefighter positions and shortens response intervals.

departments.name: Public Works & Streets
departments.blurb: Street repair, signals, striping, storm drains, city facilities and fleet.
departments.cutNarrative: Pothole backlog grows and the pavement condition index keeps sliding.
departments.raiseNarrative: Clears the pothole backlog and resumes the slurry seal program.

departments.name: Parks & Recreation
departments.blurb: Parks maintenance, youth and senior programs, pool, community events.
departments.cutNarrative: Reduced program hours, browner turf, shorter pool season.
departments.raiseNarrative: Restores youth programming and park maintenance cycles.

departments.name: Community Development
departments.blurb: Planning, building inspection, permits, code enforcement, engineering.
departments.cutNarrative: Permit turnaround slows, which quietly drags on future fee revenue.
departments.raiseNarrative: Faster permits and inspections; development revenue picks up.

departments.name: Administration & Finance
departments.blurb: City Manager, Clerk, Finance, HR, IT. Also where the overdue audits live.
departments.cutNarrative: Thinner finance staff. The overdue audits slip further, which lenders notice.
departments.raiseNarrative: Staffs up finance to clear the audit backlog and rebuild bank reconciliations.

departments.name: City Attorney
departments.blurb: Contracted legal services, litigation defense, ordinance drafting.
departments.cutNarrative: Less outside counsel capacity right when the city is signing loan agreements.
departments.raiseNarrative: Adds counsel capacity for the interfund loan and labor negotiations.

departments.name: Non-Departmental & Debt
departments.blurb: Debt service, insurance, liability, citywide transfers. Mostly contractual.
departments.cutNarrative: You can defer very little here without missing a contractual payment.
departments.raiseNarrative: Pays down obligations ahead of schedule.

projection.note: Baseline growth assumptions for the three-year outlook.
projection.expenditureGrowthNote: Salary steps, CalPERS rate increases and insurance renewals outrun revenue growth. This is the structural problem.
